nodes.description: Address of the contract owner set in an Ownable constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Total token supply; written by the TCNYCoin constructor, burn and mintToken.
Mapping of address to token balance; updated by transfer, transferFrom, burn, mintToken and the constructor.
Nested mapping address => address => uint storing ERC20 allowances.
Public mapping marking addresses as frozen; written by freezeAccount.
Human readable token name ("TCNY") set in the TCNYCoin constructor.
Token symbol ("TCNY") set in the TCNYCoin constructor.
Number of decimals (6) set in the TCNYCoin constructor.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances, allowances and minting.
Ownable() constructor: assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function that writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier: requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function body.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint,uint): asserts b <= a and returns a - b.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint,uint): computes c = a + b and asserts no overflow before returning c.
SafeMath.sAssert(bool): reverts when the assertion is false.
ERC20 transfer(address,uint): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 transferFrom(address,address,uint): moves tokens using the msg.sender allowance and safeSub/safeAdd.
Constant function returning balances[_owner].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
Constant function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Destroys _value tokens from msg.sender and reduces totalSupply using safeSub.
TCNYCoin() constructor: initialises totalSupply, balances[msg.sender], name, symbol and decimals.
Payable fallback function that accepts ether without any accounting.
TCNYCoin.transferOwnership(address): moves the owner balance to the new owner then calls Ownable.transferOwnership.
onlyOwner function that performs an external call to an arbitrary tokenAddress to move tokens to owner.
onlyOwner function that writes frozenAccount[target] and emits FrozenFunds.
onlyOwner function that increases balances[_toAcct] and totalSupply via safeAdd and emits Transfer events.
External call ERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, amount) to a caller-supplied contract address.
newOwner argument of Ownable.transferOwnership.
a argument of safeSub.
b argument of safeSub.
a argument of safeAdd.
b argument of safeAdd.
Local variable c = a + b inside safeAdd.
assertion boolean argument of sAssert.
_toAcct recipient argument of transfer.

_toAcct recipient argument of transferFrom.
_value amount argument of transferFrom.
Local variable _allowance caching allowed[_fromAcct][msg.sender].
_owner argument of balanceOf.
_spender argument of approve.
_value allowance argument of approve.
_owner argument of allowance.
_spender argument of allowance.
_value amount argument of burn.
_newOwner argument of TCNYCoin.transferOwnership.
tokenAddress argument of transferAnyERC20Token (untrusted external contract).
amount argument of transferAnyERC20Token.

_toAcct recipient argument of mintToken.
_value minted amount argument of mintToken.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the initial owner in the Ownable constructor, making ownership caller-controlled.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
onlyOwner guards the body of Ownable.transferOwnership.
onlyOwner guards the body of TCNYCoin.transferOwnership.
onlyOwner guards transferAnyERC20Token, the external-call function.
onlyOwner guards freezeAccount.
onlyOwner guards mintToken, the token issuance function.
transferOwnership reads the owner state variable to validate the caller.
transferOwnership writes the new value into the owner state variable.
TCNYCoin constructor assigns the whole supply to balances[msg.sender].
Constructor initialises totalSupply with literal arithmetic.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
Constructor sets the token name.
Constructor sets the token symbol.
Constructor sets the decimals value.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], a caller-controlled key.
transfer writes both the sender and recipient balance entries.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key of the allowance mapping.
transferFrom updates the source and destination balances.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[_fromAcct][msg.sender].
approve grants an allowance keyed by msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
burn destroys tokens from balances[msg.sender].
burn reduces the caller balance entry.
burn reduces totalSupply.
transfer performs balance subtraction through safeSub.
transfer performs balance addition through safeAdd.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balances and allowance.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient balance.
burn uses safeSub for balance and totalSupply.
TCNYCoin.transferOwnership aggregates balances with safeAdd.
mintToken increases balances and totalSupply with safeAdd.
safeSub enforces b <= a through sAssert before subtracting.
safeAdd enforces c >= a && c >= b through sAssert to prevent overflow.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
TCNYCoin.transferOwnership moves the owner balance to the new owner.
TCNYCoin.transferOwnership reads balances[owner] before zeroing it.
TCNYCoin.transferOwnership internally calls Ownable.transferOwnership to change owner.
freezeAccount writes frozenAccount[target] for an arbitrary target address.
mintToken credits balances[_toAcct].
mintToken increases totalSupply.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on a caller-supplied contract, an external call.
A malicious tokenAddress can execute arbitrary code and reenter transferAnyERC20Token during the external call.
The owner address is the recipient passed to the external token transfer.
Parameter a feeds the subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter b is the bound checked by sAssert inside safeSub.
Parameter a is an operand of the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of the addition inside safeAdd.
Local c holds a + b and is the value returned by safeAdd.
The assertion flag controls whether sAssert reverts.
newOwner is the value written to the owner state variable.
_toAcct is the credited account in transfer.
_value is the amount moved by transfer.
_fromAcct is the debited account in transferFrom.
_toAcct is the credited account in transferFrom.
_value is the amount moved by transferFrom.
_allowance caches the allowance before it is decremented via safeSub.
_owner is the mapping key read by balanceOf.
_spender receives the allowance granted by msg.sender in approve.
_value is the allowance amount written by approve.
_owner is the outer mapping key read by allowance.
_spender is the inner mapping key read by allowance.
_value is the amount destroyed by burn.
_newOwner is the destination of the migrated owner balance.
tokenAddress selects the external contract whose transfer is invoked.
amount is the value forwarded to the external token transfer.
target is the address written into frozenAccount.
freeze is the boolean value written into frozenAccount.
_toAcct is the account credited by mintToken.
_value is the amount minted and added to totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: Function argument is fully normalised into the onlyOwner ownership-transfer function that consumes it.
First operand of safeSub only exists to feed the checked subtraction.
Second operand of safeSub only exists to feed the checked subtraction.
First operand of safeAdd only exists to feed the checked addition.
Second operand of safeAdd only exists to feed the checked addition.
Local accumulator c = a + b is an internal temporary of safeAdd.
Assertion flag is consumed only by the sAssert revert helper.
Recipient argument is only used inside the transfer function body.
Amount argument is only used inside the transfer function body.
Source argument is only used inside the transferFrom function body.
Recipient argument is only used inside the transferFrom function body.
Amount argument is only used inside the transferFrom function body.
Cached allowance temporary exists only for the transferFrom allowance update.
Mapping key argument is only used by the balanceOf view function.
Spender argument is only used to key the approve allowance write.
Allowance amount argument is only used by approve.
Outer mapping key argument is only used by the allowance view function.
Inner mapping key argument is only used by the allowance view function.
Burn amount argument is only used inside the burn function.
New owner argument is only used by the balance-migrating ownership transfer.
tokenAddress is the untrusted target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
amount is forwarded directly into the external ERC20 transfer call.
Target address is only used to key the frozenAccount state write.
Freeze flag is only used to set frozenAccount[target].
Recipient argument is only used by the mintToken issuance routine.
Mint amount argument is only used by the mintToken issuance routine.
